title: Keep the two run meanings clear
when: When a QA execution starts or the user first inspects Activity alongside a deployment run.
need: A deployment run ships a candidate. A QA plan execution coordinates cases; individual QA runs are attempts on their requirements, producing artifacts and verdicts. A screenshot or completed capture may still await review.
surface: QA Activity/case page; plan execution output; reference records
gap: Review question: should JOURNEYS give the first QA activity view this short vocabulary instead of calling every layer a run?
surface_notes: QA execution / attempt output → evidence and verdict: Continuation state names what happens next. The saved attempt/artifacts/verdict establish only the declared subject, target and candidate; a capture may still await review.
